scope: Extend the bounded headless original-vs-managed differential probe for the world-independent NativePathFinder dependency. No production source changed in this slice.

probe.mode: Headless Java reflection probe. Original JAR and managed classes were loaded through separate URLClassLoaders with the platform class loader as parent.
covered_behavior: all 256 byte values through state normalization
updateChunk count, null-index, coordinate, and normalization boundaries
processChunk remaining lengths 0, 1, 8, 9, 10, 17, 18, 19, 71, 72, 73, 255, 256, 257, 511, 512, and 513; caller ByteBuffer position/limit preservation
loadCache record and legacy-buffer length boundaries with varied count arguments
updateHeights count boundaries and clearCache clearing both native-helper maps
72 deterministic randomized blocked 3D grids across cardinal/diagonal movement and node budgets -1, 0, 1, 8, 64, and 4096; findPath/canReach consistency
same-position path when the position is marked blocked

comparison.run_stdout_line_endings_normalized: Captured Windows CRLF converted to LF for the committed evidence file; output text is unchanged.

validation_limits.status: This is expanded differential evidence for world-independent helper behavior only. It does not establish all helper inputs, world collision behavior, normal Pathfinder entry/execution, disk event integration, macro behavior, or server compatibility.
